original.target_description: VABS Composite: repeated-measures ANCOVA between EIBT and comparison groups, pretreatment score as covariate and Years 1–3 as repeated dependent measures. Main group effect in Table 2.

n.sample_role: Children retained in the target repeated-measures ANCOVA, summed across mutually exclusive EIBT and comparison groups. Repeated annual scores are not counted as independent participants.
n.exclusions: Five dropouts excluded before the final 21-per-group cohort (3 EIBT, 2 comparison); outcome-specific complete-case analysis removes participants missing any required time point. Table 2 supplies final analytic group counts. Intervention discontinuers with completed follow-up were retained, per p. S147.

replication.target_description: VABS Composite change over baseline and three annual assessments, EIBI versus SAU; age-adjusted linear mixed-model time-by-treatment interaction (difference in slopes).

n.sample_role: Repeated-measure observations in the VABS Composite model, as printed in Table 3; not a count of independent children.
n.exclusions: Study enrolled 94 children (48 EIBI,46 SAU). Intention-to-treat analyses use available longitudinal data. Two EIBI children lost to follow-up; five SAU families declined Year 3 testing. Outcome-specific counts retained exactly as Table 3 prints them.
